desc:
🐶 Welcome to +1 Pet Size!

How to Play:
💪 Click to grow your pet BIGGER and BIGGER
🏃 Ride your pet down the track and SMASH through walls
💰 Earn cash for every wall you break
🗺️ Unlock 8 worlds: from Meadow to the Underworld
🥚 Hatch eggs to collect rare and Mythic pets
✨ Find Golden, Rainbow and Shadow mutations
⬆️ Buy upgrades to grow faster, earn more and get luckier
🔁 Rebirth for permanent boosts
🎁 Claim daily rewards and playtime gifts

👥 Join the group to unlock Triple Hatch for FREE!
🔑 Use code WORLD2 for free rewards!

⚠️ WARNING: This game contains flashing lights
🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile and Tablet players
